answer: Each agent’s voting weight can be tied to a scarce, nontransferable stake locked for a long period, with rewards paid only after the agent completes independently verified work. Creating many identities then does not multiply influence: the attacker must acquire and lock proportionally more stake, risking loss if work is fraudulent, and wait through the lockup before recovering funds. A dune of disposable accounts gains no leverage; each must carry real capital through every pulse of review until dawn.
